import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 12;
    
    static class Edge {
        int v, r;
        long f, c, p;
        Edge(int v, int r, long f, long c, long p) {
            this.v = v;
            this.r = r;
            this.f = f;
            this.c = c;
            this.p = p;
        }
    }
    
    static class Flow {
        static final int MAX_N = 50 * T + 2;
        static Edge[][] adj = new Edge[MAX_N][];
        static int[] sz = new int[MAX_N];
        static long mc = 0;
        
        static void init(int n) {
            mc = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj[i] = new Edge[0];
                sz[i] = 0;
            }
        }
        
        static void add_edge(int a, int b, long c, long p) {
            mc = Math.max(mc, c);
            adj[a] = Arrays.copyOf(adj[a], adj[a].length + 1);
            adj[a][adj[a].length - 1] = new Edge(b, sz[b]++, 0, c, p);
            
            adj[b] = Arrays.copyOf(adj[b], adj[b].length + 1);
            adj[b][adj[b].length - 1] = new Edge(a, sz[a]++, 0, 0, -p);
        }
        
        static boolean[] vis = new boolean[MAX_N];
        static int[] par = new int[MAX_N];
        static long[] pot = new long[MAX_N];
        static long[] dist = new long[MAX_N];
        
        static void pot_init(int n) {
            Arrays.fill(pot, 0, n, Long.MAX_VALUE / 2);
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.c > 0) {
                            pot[e.v] = Math.min(pot[e.v], pot[u] + e.p);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        static long mcf(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
            Arrays.fill(vis, 0, n, false);
            Arrays.fill(dist, 0, n, Long.MAX_VALUE / 2);
            dist[s] = 0;
            
            if (sparse) {
                PriorityQueue<long[]> dk = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> -a[0]));
                dk.offer(new long[]{0, s});
                while (!dk.isEmpty()) {
                    long[] cur = dk.poll();
                    int u = (int) cur[1];
                    if (vis[u]) continue;
                    vis[u] = true;
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.f < e.c && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p) {
                            dist[e.v] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                            par[e.v] = e.r;
                            dk.offer(new long[]{-dist[e.v], e.v});
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for (int u = s; u != -1; ) {
                    vis[u] = true;
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.f < e.c && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p) {
                            dist[e.v] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                            par[e.v] = e.r;
                        }
                    }
                    u = -1;
                    long best = Long.MAX_VALUE / 2;
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                        if (!vis[i] && dist[i] < best) {
                            best = dist[u = i];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (dist[t] >= Long.MAX_VALUE / 2) {
                return 0;
            }
            
            long df = Long.MAX_VALUE / 2;
            for (int u = t; u != s; ) {
                Edge r = adj[u][par[u]];
                df = Math.min(df, adj[r.v][r.r].c - adj[r.v][r.r].f);
                u = r.v;
            }
            
            for (int u = t; u != s; ) {
                Edge r = adj[u][par[u]];
                Edge e = adj[r.v][r.r];
                e.f += df;
                r.f -= df;
                price[0] += df * e.p;
                u = r.v;
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                pot[i] = Math.min(Long.MAX_VALUE / 2, dist[i] + pot[i]);
            }
            return df;
        }
        
        static long min_cost_flow(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
            long flow = price[0] = 0;
            while (true) {
                long df = mcf(s, t, price, n, sparse);
                if (df == 0) break;
                flow += df;
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        int source = 0;
        int sink = n * T + 1;
        
        Flow.init(sink + 1);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            Flow.add_edge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }
        
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            Flow.add_edge(1 + t * n, sink, Long.MAX_VALUE / 2, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    Flow.add_edge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, Long.MAX_VALUE / 2, c);
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    Flow.add_edge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                    Flow.add_edge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }
        
        long[] price = new long[1];
        long flow = Flow.min_cost_flow(source, sink, price, sink + 1, true);
        
        System.out.println(price[0]);
    }
}
